create_robotics_client_cloud: create a Client with robotics_api_connection set to CLOUD to call the Gemini robotics API
create_robotics_client_local: create a Client with robotics_api_connection set to LOCAL to call a local gRPC robotics server
generate_robotics_content: generate content by calling client.models.generate_content with images and a JSON observations string
convert_contents_to_genai_format: convert robotics contents including numpy arrays and tensors to GenAI API format using update_robotics_content_to_genai_format
connect_to_grpc_server: connect to a local gRPC server by calling _connect_to_grpc with a grpc URL string
